spanish: Y dijo: Si, te ruego, hallé favor en tus ojos, Señor mío, ande, te ruego, Señor mío en medio de nosotros, porque pueblo duro de nuca él, y perdonarás a nuestra iniquidad y a nuestro pecado, y nos heredarás.
grammarChanges: Replaced temporal «ahora» (both occurrences) with the entreaty «te ruego», set off by commas, to render נא (h02034009003, h02034009009) as a request particle rather than a time adverb.

Changed the imperatives «perdona» and «herédanos» to the future indicative «perdonarás» and «nos heredarás» to keep the qal perfect 2ms, non-imperative force of h02034009017 and h02034009020; person, number, stem, and the 1cp object were kept.
readerNote: Rendered נא as the parenthetical entreaty «te ruego» instead of temporal «ahora», and rendered the two qal perfect verbs as future indicative («perdonarás» / «nos heredarás») instead of imperative to keep their perfect, non-command force.
